text:
## Side-by-Side Pricing Plans: Design Ideas for Pricing Page
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000076998

## Designing Side-By-Side Pricing Table Pages:
Text and Images can be added inside the Text Editor and the content will appear on the Join Page:
Additional Information:
» Everything About WYSIWYG Editors
» How to Post Images On WYSIWYG Editors
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180595532/original/J38bb2amkSHjNW7fCAy0PhXSyuQEYt6puQ.png?1781715454 | alt: ]
Outcome:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180595534/original/aY3IGZ_fv7yDzSfZH_ZknRBr--XG9F1mOg.png?1781715461 | alt: ]
2) Use the Hero Section:
» How to add a Hero Section to Static pages
Outcome:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180595186/original/jjgK3DM-q3bFp4medVarIpJGH39hrxhuPw.png?1781715082 | alt: ]
3) Showcase one of the plans:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180595040/original/mzC5GUAq5masMwanixC6Wm_DAeAdpEIY_A.png?1781714967 | alt: ]
To emphasize one of the plans in your Pricing Plan Menu go to the Toolbox > Menu Manager > Side by Side Pricing Menu > Edit:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180594837/original/zKnsqxGY-vJ49Srtz4pcQ4fgzlALsX2mWQ.png?1781714832 | alt: ]
Look for the plan that will be showcased, click on Settings, and in the Outer <li> CSS Class add " showcase " next to the class that is already in place.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180595005/original/AKzElbdmWeT40r_zKl3q48i6MYfH4PtYZg.png?1781714933 | alt: ]
For additional questions or help setting this up, please submit a ticket to support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket HERE .
